macroTechs.name: Doomsday Device
macroTechs.description: A weapon platform whose blast radius is measured in 'before' and 'after.' Built once. Used, hopefully, never.

globalEffect.description: Instant map-wide devastation of all enemy structures

macroTechs.name: Precursor AI
macroTechs.description: Something old and patient wakes up inside the network, and it has been listening for a very long time.

globalEffect.description: Hijacks control of all enemy production facilities

macroTechs.name: Orbital Forge
macroTechs.description: A factory the size of a moon, built in the dark above the war, manufacturing things the war hasn't seen yet.

globalEffect.description: Unlocks orbital-tier production at all factories

macroTechs.name: Hive Mind Network
macroTechs.description: Every soldier, sensor, and turret on the field starts thinking with one mind. Casualties drop. So does anything resembling individuality.

globalEffect.description: Global command-response and coordination boost across all units

macroTechs.name: Singularity Engine
macroTechs.description: A power source built around a contained gravitational anomaly. The engineers call it stable. The anomaly has not been asked for comment.

globalEffect.description: Unlimited energy production; triggers endgame scenario

microTechs.name: Coolant Efficiency
microTechs.description: Redesigned heat-exchange manifolds bleed waste thermal energy back into the grid, rather than venting it as steam that alerts every scanner in the sector.

microTechs.name: Magnetic Containment
microTechs.description: Layered electromagnetic lattices hold reactor cores in a stable null-state, theoretically. Engineers have quietly stopped using that word in meetings.

microTechs.name: Plasma Conduits
microTechs.description: Superheated matter no longer travels through pipes; it travels through carefully negotiated agreements with pipes.

microTechs.name: Zero-Point Tap
microTechs.description: A needle pushed into the fabric of vacuum itself. Output is, officially, 'more than zero.'

microTechs.name: Nanofiber Weave
microTechs.description: Threads one molecule thick, woven by machines too small to see, into armor too strong to dent.

microTechs.name: Cryo-Forged Alloys
microTechs.description: Metal quenched at temperatures that make liquid nitrogen feel like a warm bath. Brittle in theory, unbreakable in spite.

microTechs.name: Adaptive Polymers
microTechs.description: A material that heals its own wounds, given time. Mostly given time. Sometimes given a generous interpretation of 'heals.'

microTechs.name: Exotic Matter Lattice
microTechs.description: A crystalline structure that exists in slightly more dimensions than it should, which is either a manufacturing defect or a competitive advantage.

microTechs.name: Neural Lace Prototyping
microTechs.description: Thin filaments laced through grey matter, letting commanders think a fraction of a second faster than the enemy. That fraction wins wars.

microTechs.name: Quantum Logic Gates
microTechs.description: Switches that are on, off, and 'we'll know when we check' simultaneously. Somehow this makes the missiles aim better.

microTechs.name: Synthetic Cognition
microTechs.description: An artificial mind that passes for clever in casual conversation. It has opinions about the war. It keeps most of them to itself, for now.

microTechs.name: Recursive Self-Improvement
microTechs.description: Code that rewrites itself to be better at rewriting itself. Command has asked it to stop twice. It has, technically, both times, briefly.

microTechs.name: Spore Cultivation
microTechs.description: Fungal colonies bio-engineered to digest battlefield wreckage into usable biomass. The smell is the price of efficiency.

microTechs.name: Genetic Resequencing
microTechs.description: Soldiers volunteer for the program knowing roughly forty percent of what it actually does to their DNA. Recruitment numbers remain strong.

microTechs.name: Symbiotic Grafting
microTechs.description: Living tissue fused to armor plating, so the suit heals alongside the soldier wearing it. Neither party was consulted.

microTechs.name: Hivemind Pheromones
microTechs.description: An airborne chemical signal that lets squads share reflexes instead of just orders. Friendly fire incidents have dropped. Personal space has not recovered.

microTechs.name: Automated Convoy Routing
microTechs.description: Supply trucks that pick their own roads, recalculating in real time around ambushes, craters, and at least one stretch of road that's technically on fire.

microTechs.name: Modular Fabrication
microTechs.description: Factories built from identical snap-together components, so a destroyed assembly line can be rebuilt from spare parts and spite.

microTechs.name: Orbital Drop Networks
microTechs.description: Cargo pods deorbited with pinpoint accuracy, delivering reinforcements anywhere on the map in minutes, gravity and physics permitting.

microTechs.name: Resource Reclamation AI
microTechs.description: An algorithm that looks at a battlefield full of wreckage and sees, with unsettling enthusiasm, raw materials.
